column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 4: Baal-Zebul's Defeat and Revelation
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: M-me? Lose?!
I-impossible?! What could I possibly have done wrong??
You sought to make that $$大邪神$$ armor your own...
You tried to put your hollow $$正義$$ into practice! That is the cause of your defeat!
What are you saying?!
Then what you are doing is no different from me!!
That is not true!
$$ガイ$$, when you leapt in among those $$奴隷$$s,
did you throw yourself in expecting them to accept you?!
No... Back then, I probably was not thinking about anything.
I only wanted to help them...
$$ガイ$$ acted only for what he believed in, seeking nothing in return...
The armor must have resonated with his heart!
Hahahahah! I see, I see... I lose!
As thanks for making me realize it, let me tell you something useful!
Oh my, you have become remarkably candid!
Heh... hehehe...
This is not something that will please you. Listen and tremble...
The $$総本山$$ you seek, our headquarters...
does not exist anywhere on this earth!!
What?!
The so-called $$ご主人様$$ you are searching for...
is at that $$総本山$$!
Hah... hah... heh...
